simple.meaning: properly, a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass-colt
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַיִר (H5895) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַיִר (ʻayir) means properly, a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass-colt First listed occurrence: Gen 32 16.

definitions.short: properly, a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass-colt
definitions.full: H5895. ayir עַ֫יִר noun masculine Gen 32:16 male ass (young and vigorous); — plural וַעְיָרִם 32:16 (E); suffix עִירֹה 49:11 (poem; || אֲתֹנוֺ בְּנִי ); construct מֶּרֶא עַיִר (Ges § 131c N. 2; or appositive Kö Synt. § 333 s Di and others) Job 11:12 wild ass's colt ; plural עֲיָרִים , for riding Judg 10:4 a ( 10:4 b see עִיר ), עֲיָרִם ), 12:14 , singular absolute עַיִר Zech 9:9 ; עֲיָרִים for carrying Isa 30:6 Qr (Kt עורים ), עֲיָרִם for tillage 30:24 .
definitions.rootNote: from 5782 in the sense of raising (i.e. bearing a burden);
